en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view of a historic Central European city with hills in the background. In the middle distance stands a large church with four prominent Romanesque-style towers. In the foreground is a long, three‑storey school or institutional building facing a street. The reverse side is a divided-back postcard with Hungarian text printed on the left and along the center, plus a boxed note about postage in the upper right.
